description: Comprehensive reasoning vault for polynomial expressions, classification, addition, subtraction, multiplication by monomials and binomials, FOIL method, special products, GCF factoring, and quadratic trinomial factoring.

archetypes.name: Polynomial Degree and Term Classification
archetypes.coreConcept: Identify the degree of a polynomial as the highest exponent of the variable and classify by number of terms.
archetypes.mentalModel: Dominant exponent tier determining asymptotic growth rate.

archetypes.name: Evaluating Polynomials for Given Variable Values
archetypes.coreConcept: Substitute a numerical value into the polynomial variable and evaluate following order of operations.
archetypes.mentalModel: Passing a control input through an algebraic transfer function.
archetypes.governingRelation: P(k) = a k^2 + b k + c

archetypes.name: Multiplying Monomials via Exponent Rules
archetypes.coreConcept: Multiply numerical coefficients and apply product rule for variables: (ax)(bx) = ab*x^2.
archetypes.mentalModel: Scaling area dimensions by combining linear measurement factors.

archetypes.name: Adding Polynomials and Combining Like Terms
archetypes.coreConcept: Consolidate terms with matching variable parts and identical powers: (ax^2 + bx) + (cx^2 + dx) = (a+c)x^2 + (b+d)x.
archetypes.mentalModel: Summing sorted bins of identical dimensional units.

archetypes.name: Subtracting Polynomials via Sign Inversion
archetypes.coreConcept: Subtract a polynomial by adding its additive inverse, distributing the negative sign to all terms.
archetypes.mentalModel: Flipping polarity of all incoming downstream components before combining.

archetypes.name: Multiplying a Polynomial by a Monomial
archetypes.coreConcept: Distribute the monomial multiplier to each term in the polynomial: ax(bx + c) = ab*x^2 + ac*x.
archetypes.mentalModel: Broadcasting a scaling factor across all sub-channels.
archetypes.governingRelation: ax(bx + c) = ab x^2 + ac x

archetypes.name: Multiplying Binomials using the FOIL Method
archetypes.coreConcept: Multiply four distinct pairs: First, Outer, Inner, Last, and combine middle like terms.

archetypes.name: Special Product: Difference of Squares Expansion
archetypes.coreConcept: Product of sum and difference of identical terms results in difference of squares: (ax + b)(ax - b) = a^2*x^2 - b^2.

archetypes.name: Factoring Out the Greatest Common Monomial Factor
archetypes.coreConcept: Identify the highest degree monomial dividing every term and extract via reverse distribution: abx + ac = a(bx + c).

archetypes.name: Factoring Quadratic Trinomials for Geometric Dimensions
archetypes.coreConcept: Factor monic quadratic trinomial x^2 + bx + c into (x + p)(x + q) where p + q = b and p*q = c to determine geometric dimensions.
archetypes.mentalModel: Reconstructing rectangle length and width from total area polynomial.

archetypes.name: Polynomial Kinematics and Parabolic Root Synthesis
archetypes.coreConcept: Model projectile trajectory height using quadratic polynomials and factor to determine time of flight and ground impact.
archetypes.mentalModel: Parabolic arc root extraction in classical mechanics.
archetypes.governingRelation: h(t) = v_0 t - g t^2 = 0 \implies t = \frac{v_0}{g}
